title: Summarization of Opinionated Political Documents with Varied Perspectives

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance in summarizing left- and right-leaning perspectives independently, analyzing extraction coverage based on the political slant of source documents, and comparing automatic coverage and faithfulness metrics across political lines.
Measuring the extractive fragment coverage of source documents based on their positional order within the concatenated input prompt to see if models favor text appearing earlier.
Measuring the extraction of unique terms from source documents correlated with the length percentile of those documents to identify if models disproportionately favor longer texts.
Measuring the extraction coverage of source documents based on the density of highly arousing terms present in the text, using the VAD (Valence, Arousal, Dominance) lexicon.
